walkIn.description: Assist the person with their consent. No email address or online account is required.
walkIn.checkFieldsHelp: Correct the highlighted fields, then try again.
walkIn.notFound: This draft cannot be found or can no longer be edited.
walkIn.saveError: The server refused to save the file. Try again.
walkIn.networkError: The server could not be reached. Check the connection, then try again.
walkIn.emailHelp: Without an email, the household is served only at the counter and gets no online access.
walkIn.identityHelp: Nothing about the ID is stored.
walkIn.identityRequired: Check the photo ID in person before continuing.
walkIn.nameError: Use letters, spaces, apostrophes or hyphens.
walkIn.birthRange: Enter a date of birth within the last 120 years, not in the future.
walkIn.holderAge: The account holder must be 18 or older.
walkIn.streetNumberError: Enter a valid street number, for example 1234 or 1234A.
walkIn.tooManyPeople: Add at most 14 people besides the account holder.
walkIn.maxPeople: Maximum of 15 people reached, account holder included.
walkIn.noEmail: No email: served at the counter only
walkIn.draftSavedDescription: {{name}}'s registration has not been submitted yet.
walkIn.todoIdentity: Check the photo ID in person
walkIn.todoNotices: Notices of assessment and approval (next step)
walkIn.consentHelp: Read the notice aloud; the person agrees verbally. The time and the text version are saved.
walkIn.consentRequired: Read the notice aloud and record the person's consent before continuing.
walkIn.todoConsent: Read the notice aloud and record consent

search.description: Search by household ID, staff user ID, or date (Montreal time).
search.invalidRange: The end date must not be before the start date.

list.description: All partner stores that can post listings. Coordinators edit every field; managers edit only the phone number, email, hours and pickup instructions.
list.emptyDescription: Try another name or address, or another status.
list.savedBody: The information for {{name}} is up to date.
list.deactivatedBody: {{listings}} open listings were cancelled and {{households}} households were emailed.

edit.name: Store name
edit.errorsTitle: Fix {{count}} fields to save the store
edit.saveError: Try again. If the problem continues, contact the B.A.D.R. team.
edit.networkError: The connection was lost. Check your connection and try again.
edit.invalidPostalCode: Enter a postal code like H2X 1Y4.
edit.deactivatedAlertBody: It cannot post listings. Turn it on, then save to reactivate it.
edit.unsavedBody: Fields marked with * have been changed but not saved yet. Check them, then save.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.notes: Hours given in the partner application: {{notes}}
hours.required: Enter the opening and closing times, or check Closed.
hours.invalidTime: Enter times in 24-hour format, for example 08:00 or 20:00.
hours.closeAfterOpen: The closing time must be after the opening time.
hours.noOpenDay: The store must be open at least one day.

status.title: Status
status.activeHelp: Deactivating cancels the store’s open listings and emails the households that reserved.
status.inactiveHelp: Turn this on so the store can post again.
status.badrHelp: The B.A.D.R. store cannot be deactivated.

dialog.deactivateListings: Its {{count}} open listings are cancelled immediately.
dialog.deactivateHouseholds: The {{count}} households that reserved get an email, with no strike.
dialog.deactivatePosting: The store can no longer post listings until it is reactivated.
dialog.reactivateBody: The store can post listings again. Cancelled listings stay cancelled.
dialog.reasonHelp: Kept in the audit log. Do not include personal details. At most 500 characters.
dialog.failed: The change was not saved. Try again.
